records.name: Everts
records.evidence_locations: LPVV entry258 (Sanda Rapa), Cilme and diachronic records955; cached primary JSON inspected. Arbusow1898 edition p165/168 reports1566 Evert, not modern Everts. No independent archival-original inspection claimed.

The short form also arose in Low German, where spellings such as Evert and Ewert are recorded from at least the early 13th century.
